It's a must-stop for cyclists. They should increase staffing on weekends because if large groups arrive, they only make one coffee at a time, which takes a long time. The restrooms are clean, and you can restock drinks and snacks.

reviews.comment:
Entre para ir al baño, el cual estaba IMPECABLE!!. No solo relucia de limpieza (cosa muy poco común en los baños públicos), sino que había jabon líquido (puro,  no mezclado con agua) y toallas de papel.
Aparte destaco la amabilidad de la playera.

(Translated by Google)
I went inside to use the restroom, which was SPOTLESS!! Not only was it sparkling clean (something very rare in public restrooms), but there was liquid soap (straight, not diluted with water) and paper towels.
I also want to highlight the friendliness of the attendant.

reviewReply.comment: Muchas gracias por sus comentarios, nos alegra saber que su visita fue agradable, la esperamos nuevamente.
